competences.name: Browsing, searching and filtering data, information and digital content
competences.description: Articulate information needs; find and access data and content in digital environments.

levels.descriptor: With guidance, find data and content through a simple search.
On my own, and solving routine problems, search for data and content.
Guide others in searching and filtering data and content.

competences.name: Interacting through digital technologies
competences.description: Interact through a variety of digital technologies and select appropriate means.

levels.descriptor: With guidance, select simple digital technologies to interact.
Select well-defined digital technologies to interact.

competences.name: Developing digital content
competences.description: Create and edit digital content in different formats.

levels.descriptor: On my own, create and edit content in different formats.
